video_title: The REAL Reason The Boogie-AD-Jrue Pelicans Never Happened

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The potential of the Pelicans team with Anthony Davis and Jrue Holiday
quotes.excerpt: When I saw you, AD, Jrue Holiday, and you could have had my grandma, the fifth-grade kid, and somebody else, y'all's team was about to be nasty.
quotes.quote: When I saw you, AD, Jrue Holiday, and you could have had my grandma, the fifth-grade kid, and somebody else, y'all's team was about to be nasty.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The process of weeding out bad players in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It's basically a process where they weed out the bad to they finally find the good.
quotes.quote: In this business, it's more bad than good. It's basically a process where they weed out the bad to they finally find the good, which may result in a championship or a successful season. But for the most part, it's more bad than good in this league.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: How GMs and Presidents cycle through coaches to save their jobs
quotes.excerpt: If you get a GM job or a President job, you get to go through two or three coaches in a life cycle before they get rid of you.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: If you get a GM job or a President job, you get to go through two or three coaches in a life cycle before they get rid of you. It's like, I'm going to take over the job. Well, this isn't my guy, so I got two years with this guy. Regardless of what he does or doesn't do, this isn't my guy. That's why when they say you're a lame duck coach. Then you bring in the next guy, and then the next guy has to do your bidding. And if he doesn't work out, you're like, I thought. So I'm going to fire him, got two more. So now you've been through three coaches, you ain't drafted for shit, you got rid of your draft capital, you haven't developed for shit, you have no game plan, and you're like, how do you keep a job?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: You got about a two-year window with that.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: GMs and Presidents are often worse than the coaches
quotes.excerpt: There are worse GMs and Presidents in this league than there are coaches in this league.
quotes.quote: There are worse GMs and Presidents in this league than there are coaches in this league. By a thousand percent. GMs and Presidents will ruin a team more than a subpar coach. If you got a great GM, great President, you can have a C-plus team, or you can have a C-plus coach and be fine. If you got an A-plus coach and you got a shitty President and a shitty GM, your team is screwed.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Advice for Darius Acuff Jr. joining the Kings
quotes.excerpt: Embrace the fan base, fall in love with the city, get out there, become touchable.
quotes.quote: Embrace the fan base, man. One thing about that fan base, they show so much love from day one. You don't even have to score points, break a sweat, run up and down the court. The moment he was drafted by the Kings, they're going to give him their full support. So embrace the fan base, fall in love with the city, get out there, become touchable. Really, like I said, embrace the city because that's all that city really wants. They want somebody they can lean on, give them hope, and at the end of the day, play winning basketball. And I think that's something a young kid can bring.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of sustaining success in an NBA franchise
quotes.excerpt: There's 30 NBA franchises, but it's 30 different businesses, all run different.
quotes.quote: People don't understand, there's 30 NBA franchises, but it's 30 different businesses, all run different. You can show up in a place and be like, oh, I can see why this place has had success. You can show up in a place and be like, oh, I can see why y'all ain't been shit. This is not to disrespect Sacramento, but from your stretch there and you talented, all the success that you had individually, what is it that prevents them from having any level of sustained success?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Organizational success starts at the top, not with players
quotes.excerpt: When it comes to just having a good organization in general, don't start with the players, it starts at the top.
quotes.quote: When it comes to just having a good organization in general, don't start with the players, it starts at the top. If the plan at the top and whoever those working pieces are aren't all on the same page, it's not really a recipe that's going to work successfully. And on top of that, you know, shout out to Vivek. I mean, I got love for the dude. We had a working relationship, but I think it was just figuring out how to be an owner in this league. Some of these owners look at basketball as a hobby that they really, really love. And even with that hobby, you may love it, but that don't mean you fully understand it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of surrounding yourself with smarter people
quotes.excerpt: You still want to put people in around you that are smarter than you.
quotes.quote: If you hop into a field, interested or not, if you're smart in it or not, well-rounded in it or not, you still want to put people in around you that are smarter than you, that know the business better than you. So I feel like it was just a process of getting to that point. And honestly, I think we're at the point now where we will see a change within Sacramento.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Praise for Scott Perry's impact on the Kings
quotes.excerpt: Scott Perry is incredible. I became a fan of this guy.
quotes.quote: Scott Perry is incredible. I became a fan of this guy. He was one when I came into it, going through the draft process, he was with the Pistons at the time. I worked out with him when he was with the Pistons too. I got to know Scott and the Kings had the fifth pick, the Pistons had the seventh. I actually wanted to drop because I wanted to be a Detroit guy. I met Scott and we connected right away. As far as all my interviews and the draft process, he was the only one like I felt like we were relatable. He understood me a little more. Outside of that, his track record speaks for itself. He was one of the reasons the Knicks are starting to end the position they are in. He kick-started that. I think Scott Perry is incredible. I think that was a great hire.
